query GetUserTicks($userId: ID!, $boardType: String!) {
    userTicks(userId: $userId, boardType: $boardType) {
      climbUuid
      angle
      status
      attemptCount
      difficulty
      effectiveDifficulty
      boardseshDifficulty
      boardseshConfidence
      climbedAt
      layoutId
    }
  }
